title: Polaroid Photo Wall
description: A creative photo collage sandbox with polaroid-style cards, custom native drag-and-drop engine, FileReader-based image ingestion, dynamic z-index layering, random tilt angles, scramble/purge controls, and 2 seeded placeholder cards on boot.
author: Girish Madarkar
features: FileReader ingestion: hidden <input type=file accept=image/* multiple> triggered via UPLOAD PHOTO button. For each file, new FileReader() reads as dataURL, onload creates a polaroid card with caption from text input or filename stem

Polaroid card DOM: .polaroid container with white/cream background (#f0ead6), .photoFrame (aspect-ratio:1, object-fit:cover img or gradient placeholder), .caption strip with monospace text, random rotate(-15 to +15 deg) transform, box-shadow for depth

Custom drag engine: mousedown/touchstart on card saves {el, offsetX, offsetY} into dragData state. Global mousemove/touchmove computes newLeft/ newTop = clientPos - arenaRect.offset - offsetX/Y, clamped to [0, arenaRect - elSize]. mouseup/touchend nulls dragData. touch-action:none + preventDefault for mobile
Z-index stacking: maxZIndex counter incremented on every mousedown/touchstart, assigned to el.style.zIndex, guaranteeing grabbed card always renders above all others
Scramble Angles: iterates all .polaroid cards, sets transform = rotate(random -15..15 deg) live
Purge Board: adds .purging class (opacity 0, scale 0, rotate 90deg, transition 0.4s ease-out), then after 450ms clears arena innerHTML + resets counters + re-seeds 2 placeholder cards
Seed placeholders: 2 polaroid cards created on init with null src (gradient background + camera emoji) and positioned at 25%/55% of arena width
Count label: updates in real-time as 'N card(s)' on card creation/purge
